search: | rest /services/data/indexes splunk_server=local | search disabled=0 NOT title="_*" | eval retention_days=round(frozenTimePeriodInSecs/86400,1), target_days=180 | stats count as total_indexes count(eval(retention_days>=target_days)) as meeting_target min(retention_days) as minimum_retention | eval status=case(total_indexes=0,"Not assessed",meeting_target=total_indexes,"Pass",meeting_target>0,"Partial",1=1,"Fail"), observed=meeting_target." of ".total_indexes." active indexes meet the 180-day retrieval target", expected="All active non-internal indexes meet 180 days", details="Minimum configured retention: ".coalesce(minimum_retention,"not measured")." days" | table status observed expected details
expected_value: All active non-internal indexes meet 180 days
limitations: Configured retention does not prove historical searchability or a successful restore test. The 180-day target is the default level-1 retrieval target; select the applicable maturity target before using this as an audit conclusion.

search: | tstats summariesonly=false count where index=* earliest=-24h latest=now by index | stats dc(index) as indexes_with_events sum(count) as events | eval status=case(indexes_with_events>0,"Pass",1=1,"Not assessed"), observed=indexes_with_events." indexes received ".events." events in the last 24 hours", expected="At least one in-scope index has recent activity", details="24-hour activity signal only" | table status observed expected details
expected_value: At least one in-scope index has recent activity
limitations: Recent activity does not prove complete source coverage, source freshness, or retention.

search: | metadata type=hosts index=* | stats dc(host) as hosts | eval status=case(hosts>0,"Pass",1=1,"Not assessed"), observed=hosts." hosts observed in Splunk metadata", expected="At least one host is observed", details="Host metadata is an observed inventory signal" | table status observed expected details
expected_value: At least one host is observed
limitations: Host metadata is an observed inventory signal, not an authoritative system boundary or complete endpoint inventory.

search: index=ea_discovery earliest=-24h latest=now | stats count as events dc(ip_key) as ip_assets dc(nt_host) as host_assets dc(mac) as mac_assets dc(user_key) as user_assets | eval status=case(events>0,"Pass",1=1,"Not assessed"), observed=events." recent discovery events; hosts=".host_assets.", ip=".ip_assets.", mac=".mac_assets.", users=".user_assets, expected="Exposure Analytics produces recent discovery data", details="24-hour discovery signal" | table status observed expected details
expected_value: Exposure Analytics produces recent discovery data
limitations: Coverage depends on Exposure Analytics discovery jobs and the approved system boundary. Recent records do not prove all asset classes are represented.

search: index=ea_discovery earliest=-24h latest=now | stats count as events latest(_time) as latest_event | eval age_minutes=round((now()-latest_event)/60,1), status=case(events=0,"Not assessed",age_minutes<=1440,"Pass",1=1,"Fail"), observed=events." events; latest event ".age_minutes." minutes ago", expected="Discovery data is no more than 24 hours old", details="Freshness is measured against the latest event" | table status observed expected details
expected_value: Discovery data is no more than 24 hours old
limitations: Fresh records do not prove that all expected asset classes or systems are represented.

search: | tstats summariesonly=false count where index=* earliest=-24h latest=now by sourcetype | search sourcetype=*auth* OR sourcetype=*login* OR sourcetype=*authentication* | stats sum(count) as events dc(sourcetype) as sources | eval status=case(events>0,"Pass",1=1,"Not assessed"), observed=events." authentication events from ".sources." source types in the last 24 hours", expected="Authentication activity is searchable and monitored", details="24-hour signal only; tune sourcetypes to the approved boundary" | table status observed expected details
expected_value: Authentication activity is searchable and monitored
limitations: The generic sourcetype filter is a discovery signal and does not prove complete identity, MFA, or privileged-account coverage.

search: | tstats summariesonly=false count where index=* earliest=-24h latest=now by sourcetype | search sourcetype=*alert* OR sourcetype=*notable* OR sourcetype=*detection* OR sourcetype=*risk* | stats sum(count) as events dc(sourcetype) as sources | eval status=case(events>0,"Pass",1=1,"Not assessed"), observed=events." detection-related events from ".sources." source types in the last 24 hours", expected="Detection or alert activity is searchable", details="24-hour signal only; validate coverage against the approved detection inventory" | table status observed expected details
expected_value: Detection or alert activity is searchable
limitations: Event activity does not prove that required detections exist, are tuned, or are reviewed within the required response window.

search: | tstats summariesonly=false count where index=* earliest=-24h latest=now by sourcetype | search sourcetype=*audit* OR sourcetype=*admin* OR sourcetype=*sudo* OR sourcetype=*privilege* | stats sum(count) as events dc(sourcetype) as sources | eval status=case(events>0,"Pass",1=1,"Not assessed"), observed=events." privileged or audit events from ".sources." source types in the last 24 hours", expected="Privileged activity is searchable and monitored", details="24-hour signal only; validate account and command coverage" | table status observed expected details
expected_value: Privileged activity is searchable and monitored
limitations: Generic sourcetype discovery does not prove that all privileged identities, commands, or administrative systems are covered.

search: | tstats summariesonly=false count where index=* earliest=-24h latest=now by sourcetype | search sourcetype=*vuln* OR sourcetype=*nessus* OR sourcetype=*qualys* OR sourcetype=*tenable* | stats sum(count) as events dc(sourcetype) as sources | eval status=case(events>0,"Pass",1=1,"Not assessed"), observed=events." vulnerability events from ".sources." source types in the last 24 hours", expected="Vulnerability monitoring data is searchable", details="24-hour signal only; validate scan cadence and asset denominator" | table status observed expected details
limitations: Recent vulnerability events do not prove scan completeness, remediation timeliness, or an authoritative asset denominator.
